title: Compute epsilon versus temperature
action: Compute the relative dielectric constant ε for a range of temperatures using the 1D Ising model with periodic boundary conditions and the large‑N approximation. The required parameters are: N = 3×10²¹, applied electric field E = 100 V/m, single‑dipole moment μ = 0.6309×10⁻²³ J·m·V⁻¹, coupling constant J = −0.9315×10⁻²⁰ J, Boltzmann constant k_B = 1.380649×10⁻²³ J/K, and vacuum permittivity ε₀ = 8.854187817×10⁻¹² F/m. Evaluate ε at every 10 K from 100 K to 300 K (inclusive) and write the results to a CSV file with columns 'T (K)' and 'epsilon'.
description: Computed relative dielectric constant as a function of temperature from the 1D Ising model.
output_schema: CSV file with header: T (K), epsilon. 'T (K)' is the temperature in Kelvin (numeric), 'epsilon' is the dimensionless relative dielectric constant (numeric). The file must contain rows for T = 100, 110, …, 300 K.
